column1: You ponder her query for a few minutes before responding, "Set the KF Console to ACTIVE and we will use a Pirate Point for our next jump."\n\n The KF Console is now ACTIVE.
column2: 你思索了几分钟她的问题，然后回答道：“把 KF 控制台设为 启用，我们下一次跳跃就使用海盗跳跃点。”\n\n KF 控制台当前状态：启用。

column1: You rub your temples for a moment, "I just cannot see the logic in blindly replacing a possibly good part.  We'll just have to adjust to dealing with this random knocking noise.  At least it's not happening all the time."\n\nDr Murad nods and instructs her team of astechs to begin to reassemble the panels of the Console.  As they work, she turns back to you, "I'll let you know when whichver faulty component finally fails and takes the Console fully offline."
column2: 你揉了揉太阳穴：“我实在看不出盲目更换一个可能完好的部件有什么道理。看来只能先适应这阵随机出现的敲击声了。至少它不是一直响个不停。”\n\n穆拉德博士点点头，指示技术员们开始重新装回控制台面板。工作期间，她转身对你说道：“等哪个故障部件最终彻底失效、让控制台完全下线时，我会通知你。”

column1: Introduced in the late 31st Century on Solaris VII, the Combat Shield is a movable piece of armor that can be mounted on BattleMechs. The shield was first introduced as a method to add protection for a MechWarrior fighting in the arenas of Solaris. Shields are primary defensive equipment used to protect a 'Mech from Weapons fire and some forms of physical attacks. Equipping more than 1 wont yield additional effects, does not stack with other combat shields.
column2: 战斗护盾于 31 世纪末在索拉里斯七号投入使用，是一种可以安装在战斗机甲上的可移动装甲。它最初用于保护在索拉里斯竞技场作战的机甲战士。护盾主要用于防御武器火力和部分近身攻击，保护机甲免受伤害。安装超过 1 面护盾不会产生额外效果，也不会与其他战斗护盾叠加。

column2: 乍看之下，你可能会以为这只是普通的海盗破烂货，但它其实是一台大体完好的 SLDF 黄蜂，配备了原型手持武器系统。 特性：精准武器 - 手持 部署费用倍率：1.01

column1: The Fa Shih duplicates many of the features of the Inner Sphere Standard battle armor, including its jump capacity and most of the weaponry used. However the suit went against battle armor philosophy at the time by emphasizing defensive capabilities as much as offensive. Quirk: Inspiring Appearance Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount any unit, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 法石战斗装甲沿用了许多内天体标准战斗装甲的设计，包括跳跃能力和大部分武器配置。不过，这套装甲在当时背离了战斗装甲理念：它对防御能力的重视不亚于攻击能力。 特性：鼓舞外观 部署费用倍率：0.888 可搭载任意单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: You turn back to Darius shaking your head,  "That MechWarrior failed the Trial, as well as ended up in the infirmary.  I have no need of one such as them within our ranks."
column2: 你摇着头转向达利乌斯：“那名机甲战士没能通过试炼，还进了医务室。我不需要这样的人留在我们的队伍里。”

column1: You look at Darius, "Find out where my opponent is now and bring me a bondscord. We will do this the Clan way." Darius heads off to look for the fallen MechWarrior. Advance a day to get the results
column2: 你看向达利乌斯：“查清我的对手现在在哪里，把一根束缚绳带回来。我们按氏族的方式解决。” 达利乌斯离开去寻找那名落败的机甲战士。 推进一天以获取结果

column1: Based on Mad Dog's looted during Operation Bulldog has Skobel Mechworks released this design, Having to rely on Inner Sphere technologies forced them to Upgrade the Chassis by 10 Tons, despite sporting Clan Grade base Armor and Endo Steel and a permanently mounted Chin Turret. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 斯科贝尔机甲工坊根据缴获的疯狗机甲进行了这项设计，并在“斗牛犬行动”后将其发布。由于只能依赖内天体技术，他们不得不将底盘增重 10 吨，尽管它仍采用氏族级基础装甲、内骨骼，并永久安装了下巴炮塔。 特性：战斗计算机 部署费用倍率：1.16 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: On second thought, Neg.
column2: 转念一想，不。

column1: The first BattleMech to utilize the advanced Void Signature System, while reports of 'invisible 'Mechs' had long been ignored as confusion for such Star League era stealth systems as the Null Signature System and Chameleon Light Polarization Shield, allowed the 'Stealth Raptor' to be used with deadly effect.
column2: 第一台采用先进虚空特征系统的战斗机甲。长期以来，关于“隐形机甲”的报告都被当作误将星盟时代的隐形系统（如零特征系统和变色偏振护盾）认作混乱现象而遭到忽视；这让“隐形迅猛龙”得以发挥致命效果。

column1: The Tercio is the Escorpión_Imperio's flagship BattleMech. The 185 ton behemoth is focused on massive firepower and supporting it with advanced technology to maximize its efficiency. Although constructed only in limited numbers, the Tercio has quickly gained a reputation of being able to overwhelm even the most reinforced of positions.
column2: Tercio 是 Escorpión_Imperio 的旗舰战斗机甲。这头重达 185 吨的巨兽以强大火力为核心，并以先进技术提升火力运用效率。虽然产量有限，Tercio 很快就因足以压垮最坚固阵地而声名远扬。

column1: The Thunderbird was created by Clan Nova Cat as a replacement Heavy Battle Armor. Its development started in the mid-3080s as a needed replacement for their touman's dwindling supply of frontline Elemental Battle Armor.
column2: 雷鸟由新星猫氏族制造，用于替代重型战斗装甲。它于 3080 年代中期开始研发，目的是填补氏族前线元素战斗装甲日益枯竭的缺口。

column1: The Purifier Adaptive battle armor is produced by Word of Blake, though the original data was stolen from ComStar. The Purifier Adaptive is revolutionary in that it uses mimetic, color-shifting armor. The Mimetic Armor makes the Purifier Adaptive much more difficult to target, especially when it is motionless. The drawback comes in the amount of armor it carries
column2: 净化者自适应战斗装甲由圣言之书生产，最初的数据则是从 ComStar 窃取而来。它采用会变色的拟态装甲，堪称革命性设计。拟态装甲让净化者自适应装甲更难被锁定，静止时尤其如此。代价是它能携带的装甲量受到限制。

column1: The Imp II was developed as the next generation Command Mech by Clan Wolf and Clan Diamond Shark together. The result is a 140 ton, heavily armored 'Mech filled with EWS and lance coordination equipment, but is generally seen as a failure due to its lack of proper firepower for its cost.
column2: Imp II 由狼氏族与钻石鲨氏族共同研发，是新一代指挥机甲。它重达 140 吨，装甲厚重，配备 EWS 和长枪协调设备；但由于与成本相比火力不足，通常被视为失败之作。

column2: 莫尔-里奥汉

column1: In a bid to join the Arms Race of Inner Sphere OmniMech Designs, Hellespont reacted with an attempt to upgrade their most iconic salespiece, the UrbanMech. Dubbed the 'Mobile Turret', it does what every 'Urbie' has done before. Sadly, the increased cost and expertise required for maintenance, left it mostly unsold. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 为了加入内天体全能机甲的军备竞赛，赫勒斯庞特试图升级其最具代表性的畅销产品——城市机甲。它被冠以“移动炮塔”之名，做的仍是每台“小乌龟”过去一直在做的事。可惜维护所需的成本和专业能力都更高，结果几乎无人问津。 特性：360° 躯干旋转 部署费用倍率：0.95 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The Thunderbird was created by Clan Nova Cat as a replacement Heavy Battle Armor. Its development started in the mid-3080s as a needed replacement for their touman's dwindling supply of frontline Elemental Battle Armor. Quirk: Well Designed Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.952 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: 雷鸟由新星猫氏族制造，用于替代重型战斗装甲。它于 3080 年代中期开始研发，目的是填补氏族前线元素战斗装甲日益枯竭的缺口。 特性：设计精良 部署费用倍率：0.952 可搭载全能单位，可近战，不可群袭。

column1: The Thunderbird was created by Clan Nova Cat as a replacement Heavy Battle Armor. Its development started in the mid-3080s as a needed replacement for their touman's dwindling supply of frontline Elemental Battle Armor. Quirk: Well Designed Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.955 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: 雷鸟由新星猫氏族制造，用于替代重型战斗装甲。它于 3080 年代中期开始研发，目的是填补氏族前线元素战斗装甲日益枯竭的缺口。 特性：设计精良 部署费用倍率：0.955 可搭载全能单位，可近战，不可群袭。

column1: Vengeance Industries, attempting to get a foothold in the Market for OmniMechs, have redesigned the ancient Talos based on 'liberated' blueprints from Vandenberg MilTech. With a focus on easily maintainable parts, they have ensured that it can be repaired with spares from any Talos model. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Vengeance Industries 试图在全能机甲市场站稳脚跟，于是根据范登堡军工的“解放”蓝图重新设计了古老的 Talos。它采用易于维护的部件，因此可以使用任何 Talos 型号的备件进行维修。 特性：易于驾驶 部署费用倍率：0.99 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: When the Argo arrives at the source of the distress beacon, it's clear you made the right decision. A handful of void-suited passengers spin aimlessly away from a gaping hole in the hull, hoping against hope for rescue.\n\nYour tech staff manage to scoop up the survivors just before the transport explodes.
column2: 阿耳戈号抵达遇险信标源头时，你确信自己做出了正确决定。几名身穿真空服的乘客从舰体裂开的巨大破口旁无助地旋转漂浮，拼命等待救援。\n\n技术组在运输船爆炸前及时救起了幸存者。

column1: In an attempt to marry OmniTechnology to a Advanced Stealthed Land Air Mech have Shengli Arm's created the 'Berkut' based on recovered Shadowhawk LAM designs. Only being able to mount a limited amount of Slots was the Design still considered a success. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 胜利装甲试图将全能技术与先进隐形空天机甲结合，于是根据回收的影鹰 LAM 设计制造了“别尔库特”。虽然可安装的槽位有限，这一设计仍被认为是成功的。 特性：空天机甲 部署费用倍率：1.04 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Named for a shapeshifting Monster of Terran Philippine Folklore, the Aswang OmniMech employs advanced and experimental technologies, including a mimetic armor, to blend into the night and hunt its victims. Quirk: AR20 WarFare Suite Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 阿斯旺以特兰土菲律宾民间传说中的变形怪物命名。这台全能机甲采用包括拟态装甲在内的先进实验技术，能够融入夜色并猎杀受害者。 特性：AR20 战争套件 部署费用倍率：1.02 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Cooperating with the Republic did Luthien Armor Works manage to create a upgraded version of the early Avatar OmniMech. Employing Advanced Technologies could it only be produced in limited numbers. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 卢希恩装甲工坊与共和国合作，成功打造出早期阿凡达全能机甲的升级版。由于采用先进技术，该型号只能限量生产。 特性：通信增强 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Odin Manufacturing built this for former KungsArmé soldiers after they got folded into the Ghost Bear Dominion. Those veterans wanted something that fit how they fought and the Dengier delivered. Ten official variants by 3155, which tells you how well the base chassis worked. Ghost Bear warriors eventually started using it too, which is about as good an endorsement as you can get.
column2: 奥丁制造为那些并入幽灵熊自治领的前昆斯军团士兵打造了这台机甲。老兵们需要一台符合自身战斗方式的机甲，而 Dengier 交出了满意答卷。3155 年前已确立十种官方变体，这足以说明基础底盘有多成功。后来连幽灵熊战士也开始使用它——这已经是最高级别的认可。

column1: Experimental Weapons Platform
column2: 实验武器平台

column1: All incoming damage reduced by 30%.
column2: 所有受到的伤害降低 30%。

column1: When StarCorps Industries wanted to move into the superheavy market, they created the Peacemaker. With a familiar exterior design they hoped to build on top of the Warhammer's reputation for being "just enough". However, the final product instead turned into a PPC focused 155 ton superheavy, which was not cheap nor as versatile as the Warhammer.
column2: 星际军团工业进军超重型市场时制造了和平缔造者。他们采用熟悉的外形设计，希望延续战锤“刚刚好”的声誉。然而最终产品却变成了一台以 PPC 为核心、重达 155 吨的超重型机甲，既不便宜，也没有战锤那么灵活。

column1: Requiring a more advanced and enduring Command Unit, designers have revisited the original Black Knight Specs. Taking cues from the Harjel system of Battle Armor, and advances from Clan Diamond Shark, this mech is outfitted with a specialized diagnostics and self repair system. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 由于需要更先进、更耐用的指挥单元，设计师重新审视了黑骑士的原始规格。他们借鉴战斗装甲的 Harjel 系统以及钻石鲨氏族的技术进展，为这台机甲配备了专用诊断与自我修复系统。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.08 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The Gùn is a moderately fast light OmniMech which was designed by the Capellan Confederation as an Infantry Support 'Mech. Designed with 10 tons of pod space, the default configuration of the Gùn features a combination of anti-infantry and anti-vehicle energy weaponry. The 'Mech also features a Small Cockpit and an XL Gyro. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.92 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Gùn 是一台速度适中的轻型全能机甲，由联邦制设计为步兵支援机甲。它拥有 10 吨挂载舱空间，默认配置结合了反步兵与反载具能量武器。此外还配备小型驾驶舱和 XL 陀螺仪。 特性：短程瞄准增强 部署费用倍率：0.92 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: You rub your temples for a moment, "Go ahead and proceed with the repairs.  No use worrying about what I should have done to prevent this."\n\nDr Murad nods and instructs her team of astechs to begin repairing the damage to the Console.
column2: 你揉了揉太阳穴：“继续维修吧。现在再担心本该如何预防也没有意义。”\n\n穆拉德博士点点头，指示技术员们开始修复控制台的损伤。

column1: The 'Badb Catha' (Battle Crow) was named for old terran irish folklore after a Goddess of Death and Chaos, foreshadowing imminent Bloodshed and sowing confusion. Part of the Morrigan OmniMech program, alongside the Mhacha and Anand. Quirk: Morrigan C3i Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: “巴德·卡塔”（战鸦）以古老的特兰爱尔兰民间传说命名，源自一位象征死亡与混乱的女神，预示着即将到来的血腥与纷争。它属于莫里甘全能机甲计划，与 Mhacha 和 Anand 同属一个系列。 特性：莫里甘 C3i 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Startled by Darius' question, you take a minute before responding, "Sorry, I was doing the budget in my head.  Have Farah and her team begin the repairs on the console."\nDarius turns to the computer to type up the work order, "On to it, Commander."
column2: 达利乌斯的问题让你一愣。你停了一会儿才回答：“抱歉，我刚才在心算预算。让法拉和她的团队开始维修控制台。”\n达利乌斯转向电脑，开始输入工单：“收到，指挥官。”

column1: Based on the Word of Blake Raptor II BattleMech, similarly employing advanced Stealth technology and Electronics is the Raptor III even more capable of deep strike scout and intercept Missions, hardmounting a unique Advanced AMS System. Quirk: Integrated Adv. AMS Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Raptor III 基于圣言之书的 Raptor II 战斗机甲设计，同样采用先进隐形技术和电子设备，但更适合执行纵深侦察与拦截任务，并固定安装了独特的高级 AMS 系统。 特性：集成高级 AMS 部署费用倍率：0.99 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The first BattleMech to utilize the advanced Void Signature System, while reports of 'invisible 'Mechs' had long been ignored as confusion for such Star League era stealth systems as the Null Signature System and Chameleon Light Polarization Shield, allowed the 'Stealth Raptor' to be used with deadly effect. Quirk: Improved Jammer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 第一台采用先进虚空特征系统的战斗机甲。长期以来，关于“隐形机甲”的报告都被当作误将星盟时代的隐形系统（如零特征系统和变色偏振护盾）认作混乱现象而遭到忽视；这让“隐形迅猛龙”得以发挥致命效果。 特性：干扰增强 部署费用倍率：1.04 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The Trinity is really three different battle armors, all initially constructed by the Capellan Confederation and therefore sharing the same base chassis. The Ying Long ("Shadow Dragon") uses the mimetic armor first created by Word of Blake for their Purifier, though how they acquired the technology is unknown. The Asterion and Theseus are functionally identical, but have different aesthetics.
column2: Trinity 实际上是三种不同的战斗装甲，最初都由联邦制制造，因此共用同一基础底盘。Ying Long（“影龙”）采用圣言之书为净化者开发的拟态装甲，但其技术来源至今不明。Asterion 和 Theseus 在功能上完全相同，只是外观不同。

column1: The Stone Giant is a 180 ton superheavy developed by Robinson Standard BattleWorks at their main research and development plant on Robinson III, loosely based on the Atlas. It's a very versatile chassis that exists in many variants with different configurations and roles. Although initially sold to Federated Suns only it soon reached new markets all over the Inner Sphere and even some larger Periphery states.
column2: 石巨人是罗宾逊标准战斗工坊在罗宾逊 III 号主要研发工厂制造的 180 吨超重型机甲，设计略微参考了擎天神。它是一款用途广泛的底盘，拥有多种配置和作战定位。最初只向联邦太阳销售，后来很快进入整个内天体，甚至一些较大的边缘邦国市场。

column1: The Legionnaire was developed as the Federated Suns answer to the Lyran Blitzkrieg, and entered production during the Word of Blake Jihad. A lance of Legionnaires played an important role in the Third Battle of New Avalon, where they quickly assaulted the Blakist force's left flank as they were attempting to ford the Thames river, breaking their momentum and eventually forcing them off world. Capable of reaching 118 km/h, the Legionnaire is a fast flanker.
column2: Legionnaire 是联邦太阳对莱兰闪电战的回应，在圣言之书圣战期间开始生产。一支 Legionnaire 小队在新亚法隆第三次战役中发挥了重要作用：它们迅速攻击正在渡过泰晤士河的圣战派部队左翼，打破其攻势，最终迫使敌军撤离星球。Legionnaire 最高时速可达 118 公里，是优秀的快速侧翼机甲。

column1: The Umbriel is a 135 ton Superheavy 'Mech imagined as a continuation of the Celestial series. It carries the newly developed Superheavy version of the Void Signature System as well as the Blake developed massive Astral Hammer autocannon. It further sports the typical Blakist Omni Superheavy Mech equipment of a Buffered VDNI combined with a small cockpit and the Seraphim Suite networking system.
column2: Umbriel 是一台 135 吨超重型机甲，被视为天体系列的延续。它搭载新开发的超重型虚空特征系统，以及由布莱克开发的巨型星锤自动炮。此外还配备布莱克派超重型全能机甲的典型设备：缓冲式 VDNI、小型驾驶舱和 Seraphim 套件网络系统。

column1: The Templar III is a Dark Age era Assault Class OmniMech, first produced by General Motors for the Federated Suns. It was intended as a replacement for the original Templar, whose factory lines were destroyed during the Jihad. General Motors established a new production line on New Valencia for what was to become the next generation of the Templar with newer technologies.
column2: Templar III 是黑暗时代的强袭级全能机甲，最初由通用汽车为联邦太阳生产。它原本要替代最初的 Templar，后者的生产线在圣战期间被摧毁。通用汽车在新瓦伦西亚建立了新的生产线，制造这款采用更新技术的下一代 Templar。

column1: The Djinn is the first known example of the so-called Demon Series of battle armor designs produced by Word of Blake for their Manei Domini. The Djinn has been carefully crafted to instill fear in its enemies. Its slim profile shows that it is obviously specially designed for Manei Domini troopers, since their use of cybernetic enhancements make up for the muscular bulk that "frail" Elementals and their Inner Sphere counterparts need to operate battle armor.
column2: Djinn 是已知最早的“恶魔系列”战斗装甲，由圣言之书为其人类主宰制造。Djinn 的设计目标就是让敌人心生恐惧。它纤细的外形显然是为人类主宰步兵量身打造的，因为他们的控制论强化弥补了“脆弱”的元素战士及其内天体对手操作战斗装甲所需的肌肉体格。

column1: The Serket is a Taurian Concordat produced 140 ton Omni QuadMech based on the older Scorpion. Its name is based on the old egyptian mythology from ancient times and was coined by a member of the design team born on Pharos, in the Alexandrian Covenant.
column2: Serket 是陶里安协约生产的 140 吨全能四足机甲，基于更老的 Scorpion 设计。它的名字源自古埃及神话，由一名出生于亚历山大公国法罗斯岛的设计团队成员命名。

column1: Obtaining a large number of mostly operational Battle Cobras in the aftermath of brutal conflict in the Devil's Bath during the Battle of Tukayyid, ComStar selected the Battle Cobra as the focus of their efforts to reverse-engineer and develop their own OmniMech.
column2: 图卡伊德战役期间，魔鬼之浴发生了惨烈冲突。战后，ComStar 获得了大量基本仍能运作的 Battle Cobra，并将其作为逆向工程、开发自有全能机甲的重点项目。

column1: Clan Sea Fox built this a few years before Clan Wolf took Terra, named it after their old Diamond Shark identity. It sold well. The Federated Suns, Lyran Commonwealth, Capellans, Taurian Concordat, even the Magistracy bought their own versions. Hell's Horses ran a few variants too. Three hard-wired Medium Pulse Lasers in the left torso no matter what config you drop in, which tells you exactly how Sea Fox wanted this thing used. They built it to sell, and they built it right.
column2: 海狐氏族在狼氏族夺取 Terra 前几年制造了这台机甲，并以钻石鲨时期的旧身份为它命名。它卖得很好。联邦太阳、莱兰联邦、联邦制、陶里安协约，甚至摄政领都购买了自己的版本；地狱之马也运行着几种变体。无论采用哪种配置，左侧躯干都硬连着三门中型脉冲激光，这充分说明海狐希望它如何投入战斗。他们造它是为了销售，也确实把它造得很好。

column1: Fast Weapons Platform
column2: 快速武器平台

column1: At first you may think this is just typical Pirate Junk, but its a mostly intact SLDF Wasp with a Prototype Handheld Weapons System.
column2: 乍看之下，你可能会以为这只是普通的海盗破烂货，但它其实是一台大体完好的 SLDF 黄蜂，配备了原型手持武器系统。

column1: The Simian is a thirty-second century medium battle armor which was the brain child of Republic of the Sphere Paladin, Kara Rutherford. The design came about due in part to Paladin Rutherford's concern of the high cost of battle armor development. Her efforts to make a cost-effective design would give birth to the Simian, however, she would not live to see it enter production.
column2: Simian 是一款 32 世纪中型战斗装甲，由球体共和国圣骑士卡拉·卢瑟福构想。高昂的战斗装甲研发成本促使她开始这项设计。她希望打造一种高性价比型号，最终催生了 Simian；然而在它投入生产前，她便已去世。

column1: The Phalanx is a battle armor design created and produced by Irian Technologies in the Free Worlds League. This design is the FWLM's answer to larger, harder-hitting battle armor such as the Kanazuchi and Gnome. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.892 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: Phalanx 是由自由世界联盟的 Irian Technologies 设计并生产的战斗装甲。这一设计是自由世界联盟军事部队对 Kanazuchi 和 Gnome 等更大型、更重火力战斗装甲的回应。 特性：伏击者 部署费用倍率：0.892 可搭载全能单位，可近战，不可群袭。

column1: Renewing the Mad Cat legend, the Mk IV used some of the most powerful configurations of its grand brother, while also incorporating easier to find and replace components. Clan Sea Fox expected to experience the same success with this model, as it had with previous ones. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 为了延续 Mad Cat 的传奇，Mk IV 采用了其“兄长”最强大的几种配置，同时加入了更容易寻找和更换的部件。海狐氏族希望这款机型能取得与前代相同的成功。 特性：执行器防护 部署费用倍率：1.12 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The Logan-X, named such for some unknown reason, is an export superheavy 'Mech made by Quicsell and offloaded at a very cheap cost to the periphery states. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Logan-X 的命名原因已不可考。这是一台由 Quicsell 制造、以极低价格倾销给边缘邦国的出口型超重型机甲。 特性：易于驾驶 部署费用倍率：1.18 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The Bushranger is a Forestry and Surveyal 'Mech designed by the Star League to be deployed on planets still being 'tamed', the only design to receive unique reinforced structure and myomer more similar to Mech's far above its weight class is it not only sturdy, but able to carry large amounts of weight with ease. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - HandHeld Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: Bushranger 是星盟为部署到仍待“驯服”的星球而设计的森林与测绘机甲。它是唯一采用独特强化结构和肌腱、使其性能更接近远高于自身重量级别机甲的设计；因此不仅坚固，还能轻松携带大量载荷。 特性：精准武器 - 手持 部署费用倍率：1.03

column1: To counter Capellan Amazons, the Cavalier II features the Grenadier II's Clan-spec stealth armor, enhanced jump mobility, and an anti-personnel weapon mount Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 为了对抗联邦制的亚马逊，Cavalier II 配备了 Grenadier II 的氏族规格隐形装甲、增强型跳跃机动性和反人员武器挂点。 特性：灵活 部署费用倍率：0.888 可搭载全能单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: You ponder her query for a few minutes before responding, "Leave the KF Console inactive for now and we will continue using normal travel for our next jump."\n\n<color=#FFA500> The KF Console is currently</color><color=#FF0000> INACTIVE.</color>
column2: 你思索了几分钟她的问题，然后回答道：“先让 KF 控制台保持停用，我们下一次跳跃继续使用普通航行。”\n\n<color=#FFA500> KF 控制台当前状态：</color><color=#FF0000>停用。</color>

column1: You rub your temples for a moment, "I just cannot see the logic in blindly replacing a possibly good part.  We've dealt with this random knocking noise so far.  At least it's not happening all the time."\n\nDr Murad nods and instructs her team of astechs to begin to reassemble the panels of the Console.  As they work, she turns back to you, "I'll let you know when whichver faulty component finally fails and takes the Console fully offline."
column2: 你揉了揉太阳穴：“我实在看不出盲目更换一个可能完好的部件有什么道理。到目前为止，我们已经应付了这阵随机出现的敲击声。至少它不是一直响个不停。”\n\n穆拉德博士点点头，指示技术员们开始重新装回控制台面板。工作期间，她转身对你说道：“等哪个故障部件最终彻底失效、让控制台完全下线时，我会通知你。”

column1: You shake your head at Yang. "I told you last time no more surprises in our supply crates. Chief, I can't afford to have half of your technicians in the MedBay with a bad case of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSHITS],S.H.I.T.S.]] Not like last time."\n\nYang visibly sags in his chair as you turn to your XO. "Darius, put those crates in the incinerator before anyone gets any bright ideas."
column2: 你朝杨摇摇头：“我上次就说过，补给箱里别再塞惊喜了。老杨，要是你一半的技术员都因为那种 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSHITS],S.H.I.T.S.]] 进了医务室，我可承担不起。上次就是这样。”\n\n你转向副官时，杨在椅子上明显泄了气。“达利乌斯，把那些箱子送进焚化炉，别让任何人再动什么歪脑筋。”

column1: A Manei Domini Omicron Poltergeist Operative. All Information is Classified Omicron-5 Clearance.\n\n
column2: 一名 Manei Domini 欧米茄级 Poltergeist 特工。所有信息均属机密，仅限欧米茄-5 级权限查看。\n\n

column1: Based on recovered Clan Crossbows and ancient SLDF experimental notes, RISC and Skobel Engineers managed to create a more modern Crossbow. Employing an experimental Extra-Light Gyro and Light Engine on an Endo-Steel chassis, they managed to upgrade both its mobility and firepower. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: RISC 和斯科贝尔工程师根据回收的氏族十字弩以及古老的 SLDF 实验记录，成功打造出更现代化的十字弩。他们在内骨骼底盘上采用实验性的超轻型陀螺仪和轻型引擎，提升了机动性与火力。 特性：空袭 部署费用倍率：1.08 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Named for an ancient God of the Forges, taming the Fires of Olympus, does this OmniMech design do its ancestor, the venerable Warhammer, proud. Built with a specialized Heat Dissipating Armor is it able to withstand incoming heat damage from its opponents. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这台全能机甲以古代锻造之神、驾驭奥林匹斯火焰的赫淮斯托斯命名，没有辱没其祖先——久负盛名的战锤。它配备特制散热装甲，能够承受敌方造成的热损伤。 特性：战斗计算机 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The Sobek is a 170 ton superheavy, named after an ancient crocodile god in a long dead religion from Terra due the likeness of the 'Mech's head to an alligator. Produced within the Taurian Concordat by Vandenburg Mechanized Industries and sold to most anyone in the Periphery, it is quite a basic design for being a superheavy which makes it easy to maintain and repair.
column2: Sobek 是一台 170 吨超重型机甲，以 Terra 古老宗教中的鳄鱼神命名，因为它的机甲头部酷似短吻鳄。它由陶里安协约的范登堡机械工业生产，几乎销往所有边缘邦国。作为超重型机甲，它的设计相当基础，因此易于维护和维修。

column1: Twenty tons, Clan Omni, running at over 120 kph. Speed like that on a frame this light — it is impressive engineering, I will give Clan Burrock that. Shame about the Dark Caste connection. The pod space is tight at seven tons, so every config is making hard choices. Some do it well. Some less so. Whoever pilots one needs to keep moving and stay smart about range.
column2: 20 吨重的氏族全能机甲，速度超过 120 公里/小时。如此轻的底盘能有这种速度，确实是出色的工程，我得承认布洛克氏族做得不错。可惜它和黑暗氏族扯上了关系。挂载舱只有 7 吨，空间很紧，所以每种配置都必须做出取舍。有些配置做得很好，有些就差些。驾驶它的人必须持续移动，并时刻注意交战距离。

column1: The Praetorian is the ancestor to all other Superheavy 'Mechs. Created at the height of the first Starleague as a sign of power and prestige, it brought a totally new kind of mechanical beast to the battlefield. At 175 tons, it was so much larger than anything previously seen that it is claimed many foes fled as the mere sight of it.
column2: Praetorian 是所有其他超重型机甲的祖先。它在第一星盟鼎盛时期作为力量与威望的象征诞生，为战场带来一种全新的机械巨兽。它重达 175 吨，比此前任何机甲都大得多，据说许多敌人仅仅看到它就转身逃跑。

column1: The production Skinwalker removes the controversial triple-strength myomers of its prototype Ryoken III-XP. MechWarriors appreciated the speed boost, but the interface cockpit system made them more hesitant than other Clan MechWarriors to engage in physical combat. This rendered the myomers moot. Like its Stormcrow progenitor, the Skinwalker excels in a cavalry role, bringing heavy firepower to bear with speed and stunning accuracy
column2: 量产型 Skinwalker 移除了原型 Ryoken III-XP 上饱受争议的三重强化肌腱。机甲战士喜欢由此带来的速度提升，但接口驾驶舱系统让他们比其他氏族机甲战士更不愿进行近身战。这使强化肌腱失去了意义。和它的前身 Stormcrow 一样，Skinwalker 擅长骑兵定位，以高速和惊人精度倾泻重火力。

column1: In an attempt to marry OmniTechnology to a Advanced Stealthed Land Air Mech have Shengli Arm's created the 'Berkut' based on recovered Shadowhawk LAM designs. Only being able to mount a limited amount of Slots was the Design still considered a success.
column2: 胜利装甲试图将全能技术与先进隐形空天机甲结合，于是根据回收的影鹰 LAM 设计制造了“别尔库特”。虽然可安装的槽位有限，这一设计仍被认为是成功的。

column1: The Phalanx is a battle armor design created and produced by Irian Technologies in the Free Worlds League. This design is the FWLM's answer to larger, harder-hitting battle armor such as the Kanazuchi and Gnome.
column2: Phalanx 是由自由世界联盟的 Irian Technologies 设计并生产的战斗装甲。这一设计是自由世界联盟军事部队对 Kanazuchi 和 Gnome 等更大型、更重火力战斗装甲的回应。

column1: Flanker and All-Range Combat
column2: 侧翼突击与全距离作战

column1: Created by Clan Steel Viper as a means to carry their new Helical Railgun into battle. The 195 ton superheavy 'Mech is designed with stability in mind to counteract the huge recoil of its weapons.
column2: 钢蛇氏族制造它，是为了搭载新型螺旋轨道炮投入战场。这台 195 吨超重型机甲以稳定性为设计重点，用来抵消武器产生的巨大后坐力。

column1: Superheavy Missile Boat
column2: 超重型导弹艇

column1: Based on Mad Dog's looted during Operation Bulldog has Skobel Mechworks released this design, Having to rely on Inner Sphere technologies forced them to Upgrade the Chassis by 10 Tons, despite sporting Clan Grade base Armor and Endo Steel and a permanently mounted Chin Turret.
column2: 斯科贝尔机甲工坊根据缴获的疯狗机甲进行了这项设计，并在“斗牛犬行动”后将其发布。由于只能依赖内天体技术，他们不得不将底盘增重 10 吨，尽管它仍采用氏族级基础装甲、内骨骼，并永久安装了下巴炮塔。

column1: The Fa Shih duplicates many of the features of the Inner Sphere Standard battle armor, including its jump capacity and most of the weaponry used. However the suit went against battle armor philosophy at the time by emphasizing defensive capabilities as much as offensive.
column2: 法石战斗装甲沿用了许多内天体标准战斗装甲的设计，包括跳跃能力和大部分武器配置。不过，这套装甲在当时背离了战斗装甲理念：它对防御能力的重视不亚于攻击能力。
